items.title: Senior Certification Specialist
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Our Certification team sits within Legal & Compliance and makes sure every game and platform component LeoVegas Group launches is properly certified for each regulated market we operate in. As Senior Certification Specialist, you’ll be the team’s subject-matter expert: leading complex certification and audit projects, owning our day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs and setting how the team certifies across markets, so launches stay on track and the Group’s licences stay protected. You’ll work closely with the Gaming, Casino, Change Management and Technical Compliance teams, as well as external test labs and game suppliers, and report to the Certification Manager. It’s a role with real ownership and variety: you’ll shape procedures, turn regulatory and technical-standard changes into practical requirements, and help build the capability of the wider team by mentoring Certification Specialists and Officers. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Lead end-to-end certification and audit projects for games, platform and critical components across our regulated markets - Own day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes, timelines and escalations - Act as the senior escalation point for complex certification issues raised by the business and the certification team - Monitor regulatory and technical-standard changes and turn them into clear certification requirements - Review certificates and test reports for gaps and agree corrective actions with labs and game suppliers - Plan certification timelines with stakeholders so certification never blocks a launch - Own and improve internal certification procedures, market checklists and post-certification reviews - Mentor Certification Specialists and Officers and share jurisdiction knowledge across the team OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - In-depth knowledge of certification requirements for online gambling across multiple regulated markets - Extensive experience working with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes and resolving findings - Solid understanding of online gambling games and platforms, including game, platform and critical-component certification - Proven ability to run many certifications in parallel against fixed launch dates - Experience monitoring regulatory change and assessing its impact on certification NICE TO HAVES - Experience mentoring or coaching others - Confident user of Jira, Confluence or similar tracking tools WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home - Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply). - Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England. - Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%. - Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments. - Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply). - A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, complimentary snacks and drinks, as well as breakfasts and lunches on a weekly basis - A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun. - Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave. - Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts to keep you moving. - Work in style – at our newly renovated offices at Tailors Corner are just a 2-minute walk from Leeds Train Station. - And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team! JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Creator Manager (Influencers/Streamers)
items.description: ABOUT MEDIALICIOUS At Medialicious, we're a global growth marketing partner powering the expansion of fast-growing social gaming brands. Headquartered in Gibraltar, our mission is simple: to be the industry leader through deep domain expertise, constant innovation, and strategic scale. Working hours: 9AM - 6PM (UTC-5) THE ROLE We are seeking a strategic Senior Creator Manager to set multi brand strategy across multiple markets. You will work alongside Head of Media and Partnerships to develop the long-term creator strategy for our portfolio of brands, shaping how creators drive brand growth, audience expansion, and business performance. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - You'll build the creator strategy from the ground up, defining the right portfolio mix of macro, mid-tier, micro, streamers and influencers to hit brand and performance goals. - You'll design the operating model that makes it repeatable: sourcing frameworks, contracting, compensation models, content guidelines and performance levers. - You'll run the full creator lifecycle — sourcing, vetting, negotiation, briefing, activation, optimisation and iteration — and keep output predictable. - You'll build the reporting and tracking setup that connects soft awareness metrics through to clicks, conversions, CPA and ROAS. - You'll own a rigorous testing agenda across formats, hooks, creators and integrations, on both paid and organic distribution. - You'll partner with Performance, CRM, Creative, BI/Analytics and Product, and make sure every piece of creator content is compliant with platform, regulatory and market rules for social casino. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - A proven track record leading influencer, creator or streamer programmes end to end — ideally in gaming, social casino, iGaming, entertainment or mobile apps. - Demonstrated success running performance-driven creator programmes against hard KPIs (CTR, CPV, CPA, ROAS). - Deep hands-on expertise in creator analytics, audience assessment, brand safety and performance evaluation. - Sharp negotiation, communication and partnership management skills — you've built long-term relationships with talent, agencies and management teams. - Highly organised and proactive, comfortable leading several initiatives at once in a fast-moving environment. - Fluent English, plus a genuine passion for gaming, streaming culture and US creator trends. - Why you will love it We're small, fast and allergic to bureaucracy. You'll have real ownership from day one, direct access to decision-makers, and the freedom to build something properly good rather than sit in meetings about it. How we work: open communication in Slack (not hidden in DMs), outcomes documented in Monday.com http://Monday.com, deadlines we actually agree and keep, cameras on for calls because we like feeling connected, and communication that says it in 20 words, not 1,000. Our values are simple — PASSION and PERFORMANCE. We love the product, we want to work with the best, we hold each other accountable, we choose progress over perfectionism, and we have a strict no-arsehole policy. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

items.title: Core Network Lead, Run Team
items.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead the global build and technical integration of Full MVNO systems. In this role, you will lead a dedicated Build Team responsible for architecting, integrating, testing, and commissioning end-to-end Full MVNO capabilities across global markets. Operating under a Build-to-Run model, you and your team will build new MVNO capabilities and host MNO integrations from the ground up, execute rigorous testing, and hand over stable, operational systems to a dedicated Run team after launch. This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Mobile Core networks across voice, VoLTE, data, and SMS, strong knowledge of telecommunications regulations, and experience leading engineering and QA teams. Why People Join Us We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world. Before You Hit Apply By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform—while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity. About the Role This role is focused on driving new and expanded advertising revenue and ensuring successful business results for advertisers. You will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting to deal closure, developing long-term commercial partnerships to help advertisers achieve their business objectives while ensuring a strong and responsible experience on our platform. You’ll work closely with Customer Success Managers and key cross-functional partners to ensure advertisers achieve successful outcomes after the sale, while maintaining primary ownership of revenue growth and commercial strategy. This role is based in our Paris office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Prospect, qualify, and close new advertising opportunities, leading the full sales cycle from initial engagement through contract execution. - Own and achieve a defined revenue target within an assigned territory or vertical. - Develop and execute structured account plans to drive advertiser ROI and long-term revenue growth. - Build and maintain relationships with senior-level advertising decision-makers, delivering strategic guidance and actively gathering their feedback. - Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements. - Quantify opportunities through clear, data-driven business cases aligned to advertiser objectives. - Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to support complex deals. - Partner with Customer Success Managers to ensure seamless post-sale transitions and coordinated expansion strategies. - Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate revenue forecasting. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or client-facing strategy and consulting roles. - Have 3+ years of experience as proven advisor influencing executives and clients. - Have experience owning revenue targets and closing complex deals. - Can build structured business cases and influencing senior stakeholders (internally and externally). - Have strong verbal and written communication skills. - Can operate in ambiguous, fast-changing environments. - Understand the client’s business and priorities to define success metrics and align on partnership goals. - Translate analytical insights into compelling commercial narratives. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: External Affairs, Southeast Asia
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are looking for an experienced Singapore-based Public Policy expert to lead Anthropic’s policy engagement in Singapore and across the region. In this role, you will advance practical AI governance and support Anthropic’s commercial expansion by building strategic relationships with Southeast Asian government authorities, developing substantive policy positions and papers, and engaging in regular outreach to drive progress in AI policy and AI safety. You will draw upon established relationships with key policymakers and their staff to shape how the region approaches AI regulation and safety during a critical period of governance development. As part of this role, you will collaborate with a dynamic, geographically distributed policy team on a variety of projects, including analyzing policy proposals, drafting submissions to requests for public comment, planning and executing policy campaigns in Southeast Asia, and providing policy advice to technical colleagues. This is a foundational hire — you will be building Anthropic’s policy presence in Singapore and the region from the ground up. In this role, you will: Conduct comprehensive mapping of key Southeast Asian AI policy stakeholders and build strategic relationships with government and regional multilateral officials, think tank researchers, and civil society leaders Brief a diverse set of policy and research actors looking to better understand AI safety and AI policy opportunities in the Southeast Asia context Convene diverse stakeholders and speak at policy events such as research announcements, discussion panels, or workshops on AI safety topics Analyze emerging legislation and develop Anthropic’s engagement strategy, including preparing substantive policy submissions and response documents Support senior colleagues in external engagements by preparing meeting briefs and taking action on follow-up requests Develop new programming and generate opportunities for Anthropic to regularly engage with regional policymakers, think tanks, and non-profit organizations Collaborate with policy and technical teams to translate Anthropic research into concrete policy proposals, stakeholder education, and thought leadership opportunities tailored to national regulatory environments Develop and amplify public submissions, responses to requests for information (RFI), and policy memos written by Anthropic to drive positive change in AI policy Partner with non-profit organizations and academic researchers to publish discussion papers and policy memos on how to enable responsible AI research and development Develop and execute a convening strategy, including workshops or panels that position Anthropic as a thought leader in AI safety and governance in Southeast Asia You may be a good fit if you: Have 10+ years of professional experience in government, technology, legal, and/or other policy-relevant environments Have a track record of effective, information-rich advocacy with the government of Singapore and other regional governments and multilateral organizations Have experience analyzing legislation and engaging in regulatory processes Are energized by agency — you will be the first policy hire in the region and will be building the operation from scratch Enjoy drafting and executing complex policy campaigns that move the needle Thrive when engaging with policymakers, civil society, and think tanks to translate complex technical topics into accessible and relevant information Excel at translating high-level vision into executable operational plans Have demonstrated an ability to quickly get up to speed on complex technical areas and policy dynamics Are deeply curious about frontier technological research and are eager to work closely with technical colleagues to translate new discoveries into policy outcomes Preferred Qualifications: AI/Technology industry experience heavily preferred Experience working with international companies or organizations Academic or think tank background in AI policy or related fields Experience in both government and private sector roles Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Engineering Manager (Security)
items.location_text: San Francisco, London, Remote, Belgrade, New York City
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Perplexity's security team protects products used by millions of people and thousands of enterprises, including AI agents that browse the web, run code, and act in customer systems. The team is small, senior, and builds most of what it uses: our own detections, agents that triage and investigate alerts around the clock, continuous offensive testing, and secure-by-default platforms for the rest of engineering. We're also turning what we've built into cybersecurity products for customers, so the same team that defends Perplexity builds what we ship. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and grow Security Engineering, including the engineers building our cybersecurity products. You'll own the team's execution and people, set the technical direction for how we defend our infrastructure, products, and corporate environment, and lead the product engineering work that brings those systems to customers. You'll stay close enough to the work to run an incident or review a design yourself. You'll report to Perplexity's head of security and work with engineering, infrastructure, IT, product, legal, and our co-founders. RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead, hire, and grow a team of security engineers across detection and response, cloud and infrastructure security, application and product security, offensive security, and identity and corporate security. - Lead the engineers building our cybersecurity products: set technical direction for agent-driven products across application security, offensive testing, cloud security, and detection and response, and own delivery to design partners and enterprise customers. - Keep the internal security program and the product tightly linked, so what the team runs on Perplexity every day becomes what we ship, and customer feedback improves how we defend ourselves. - Set the roadmap for Security Engineering, balancing incident load, risk reduction, and long-term platform investments, and make clear prioritization calls. - Own security incident response operations: on-call health, escalation, cross-team coordination during incidents, and postmortems that lead to real fixes. - Drive an AI-first security program. Push the team to automate investigation, response, and remediation with agents, and hold that automation to a high bar for accuracy and safety. - Partner with engineering and infrastructure leaders to get security work into their roadmaps, from threat models and design reviews to least-privilege access and secure-by-default libraries. - Represent Security Engineering in enterprise customer security reviews, external researcher and bug bounty engagements, and audits. - Build the team's operating rhythm: clear ownership, metrics that matter (time to detect, time to contain, open risk), and written standards others can follow. - Stay hands-on: review designs and code, run investigations when needed, and keep a working understanding of the systems the team defends. items.title: Senior Manager, Accounts Payable - Payments
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales. Accounts Payable provides the trusted data, dependable execution, and financial discipline behind that experience. About the Role We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Senior Manager to own and scale supplier payment operations. You’ll be responsible for accurate, timely payments, strong controls, and dependable service as OpenAI grows. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll review and approve supplier payment runs, oversee work initiated by our BPO teams and AP agents, as well as personally resolve complex exceptions. You’ll stay close to execution during volume spikes and month-end close while building the processes, coverage, and systems the team needs to scale. You’ll partner with Procurement, Supplier Master Data Operations, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance Systems, and existing AP processing teams to make payments reliable from payment readiness through settlement reconciliation. You’ll clarify handoffs, address recurring failures, and improve ERP, banking, and procurement workflows. You’ll also apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, service, or team capacity, with appropriate controls and human review. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office (Mon-Wed) per week and we offer relocation assistance to new employees. We’re looking for someone with: - Strategic AP leadership and a hands-on approach to scaling systems and processes, with strong attention to detail. - Demonstrated ownership of complex indirect AP and supplier-payment operations, including PO and non-PO workflows. - Experience leading teams or outsourced delivery partners, setting expectations, developing capability, and managing performance. - Strong payment-control judgment and experience investigating duplicates, bank-detail changes, and payment failures. - Working depth in AP accounting, reconciliations, accrual inputs, and close coordination. - Experience translating AP needs into ERP or procurement-system improvements with measurable results. - Clear communication and the ability to influence partners and senior stakeholders in ambiguous situations. In this role, you will: - Own supplier payment operations: Review and approve payment runs for supplier and payment data accuracy, required approvals, and exception resolution. Oversee manual disbursements and payment inquiries within established authority and segregation-of-duties requirements. - Resolve complex exceptions: Act as the primary escalation point for payment holds, rejected or returned payments, potential duplicates, and close blockers. Work with Treasury, banking partners, Accounting, and AP processing teams to establish the status, resolve the cause, and verify the outcome before retrying or closing an issue. - Strengthen payment readiness: Partner with Procurement and existing AP teams to resolve invoice, PO, approval, and supplier-data gaps that affect payment. Establish clear owners and follow through on recurring upstream issues. - Support forecasting and close: Provide reliable payment forecasts and cash-needs inputs to Treasury. Reconcile payment activity and exceptions, including payments after AP close, so Accounting has the evidence it needs for close and cutoff decisions. - Maintain effective controls: Uphold SOX-aligned approvals, independent supplier bank-detail verification, segregation of duties, and audit-ready documentation. Test ERP and bank integrations, including host-to-host workflows, and introduce automation or AI with validated outputs, exception handling, and clear accountability. - Lead BPO delivery and capacity: Set clear SLAs and KPIs, review quality and performance, coach service partners, and maintain documented procedures and backup coverage. Plan for volume spikes and close demands. - Report performance and risk: Own clear reporting on payment timeliness, exceptions, rejection and return trends, forecast accuracy, service quality, and control issues. Explain priorities and progress to stakeholders and leadership. items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Web Access Engineer, Crawler)
items.description: Perplexity is hiring a Web Access Engineer for the Crawler team to build reliable fetching and rendering systems for AI-powered search. You'll work on freely available public web content, within site permissions and approved access policies, and develop the infrastructure that supplies content to downstream indexing and retrieval systems. Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale. Responsibilities - Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs. - Investigate fetch and rendering failures across DNS, TLS, HTTP, caching, redirects, and client-side rendering, and classify root causes. - Improve page loading, completion detection, and content capture to preserve relevant content and handle dynamic pages reliably. - Ensure the crawler respects site-imposed access restrictions and rate limits, identifies itself clearly, and retries only transient technical errors. - Build tools to reproduce failures, compare crawler output against expected page content, and turn findings into regression tests. - Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements. Qualifications - 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++. - Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions. - Understanding of CDN caching and content delivery, HTTP error handling, retry backoff, and server-defined rate limits. - Knowledge of page lifecycle, network idle, service workers, client-side rendering, and shadow DOM; experience debugging JavaScript and fluency with Chrome DevTools, CDP, HAR files, curl, and packet captures. - Comfort working independently when the path forward is not fully defined. Nice to have - Experience developing CDN, caching, or web performance systems. - Experience operating crawlers, headless browsers, or distributed content-acquisition systems at scale. - Contributions to a browser engine or JavaScript runtime.

items.location_text: San Francisco, Austin, New York City
items.description: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. Millions of people and teams adopt Perplexity and Computer on their own, and our enterprise marketing programs bring in thousands more leads. We've grown this far without a marketing automation platform or a dedicated Marketing Operations team. We're ready to build both. We're hiring our first Head of Marketing Operations. You'll choose and implement our first marketing automation platform. You'll own how every marketing and product lead is enriched, scored and routed. And you'll build the campaign operations, attribution and reporting that connect our B2B and enterprise marketing to pipeline and revenue. You'll report to the Head of Revenue Operations and build a team. Your first direct report is a GTM Engineer, who builds our enrichment, scoring and routing systems in code. You set the definitions, strategy and priorities for that work, and the GTM Engineer is your force multiplier for delivering it. Tech stack: Salesforce | Snowflake | dbt | Clay | Marketing automation (you'll choose it) | Reverse ETL (Hightouch or similar) | Routing and scheduling (Default, Chili Piper or similar) | Computer WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and lead the Marketing Operations team. Manage the GTM Engineer from day one, set the team's roadmap, and hire the next roles as the function grows. Stay hands-on while the team is small. - Select and implement our marketing automation platform. Run the evaluation across established and AI-native platforms, covering requirements, integrations, security, scale and total cost. Then lead the rollout: the data model, the Salesforce sync, lifecycle stages, program templates, permissions and the migration of our existing B2B email programs. - Own the lead lifecycle. Define lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, handoff SLAs and recycle rules with Marketing and Sales leadership. Make sure they are enforced the same way in the marketing automation platform and in Salesforce. - Own enrichment, scoring and routing. You are accountable for every lead being complete, accurately scored on fit, intent and product usage, and sent to nurture or to a BDR, AE or Account Manager within SLA. The GTM Engineer builds and runs these systems. You direct the work, supply marketing engagement signals to the scoring model, and answer to Sales and Marketing for the results. - Own or co-own the prospecting tools our BDRs use. Lead the implementation and evolution of these tools, which will be a combination of internally built applications and vendor solutions. Work with BDR leadership to set requirements, decide what to build and what to buy, drive adoption, and measure the impact on meetings and pipeline. The GTM Engineer delivers the internal builds and the integrations with vendor tools. - Stand up account-based marketing and sales as a motion. Work with Sales and Marketing leadership to select and tier target accounts by fit, intent and product usage, and set the level of investment for each tier, from one-to-one plans for strategic accounts to scaled programs for the broader list. Map the buying group at each account and roll individual engagement up to an account-level score that tells BDRs and AEs when to act. Design the coordinated plays that Marketing, BDRs and AEs run together across email, ads, events and outbound, with clear triggers, owners and follow-up SLAs. Measure the program by account: buying-group coverage, engagement, meetings, pipeline and win rate against comparable non-target accounts. The GTM Engineer builds the account scoring, signals and orchestration behind these plays. - Run nurture and campaign operations for B2B and enterprise marketing. Set up a repeatable way to build, test and launch email, webinar, event, paid and account-based programs. items.title: Integrated Marketing Manager - Consumer & Brand, LATAM
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. We connect global product innovation with local consumer needs, culture and behavior across Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America, contributing to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We build the ChatGPT brand through integrated campaigns, creator and social programs, partnerships and cultural experiences. We work with local and global teams to make ChatGPT relevant and useful in people’s everyday lives. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a hands-on Integrated Marketing Manager to lead Consumer and Brand campaigns across LATAM. The role is based in São Paulo and works closely with regional and global teams. You’ll turn consumer and cultural insights into a clear brief and a distinctive creative idea that shows why ChatGPT matters in people’s everyday lives. You’ll lead the work from strategy through production and launch, and build ongoing marketing programs that keep the brand relevant from always on to major campaigns. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Define the audience, cultural insight, brand objective and role for marketing in each program. - Write clear creative briefs, guide concept development and give actionable feedback to internal creative teams and external partners. - Own integrated consumer campaigns from brief through launch and measurement. Give paid, owned and earned media, social, creators, partnerships and experiences partners distinct roles in bringing the campaign idea to life. - Develop locally originated campaigns and adapt global work for Brazil and other LATAM markets without losing the core brand strategy. - Build and run ongoing consumer marketing programs around cultural moments and everyday needs. Set priorities, clarify who owns the work and use each campaign’s learnings to improve the program over time. - Align local, regional and global partners on the campaign brief, channel roles and the decisions needed to deliver the work. - Work with Creative, Production, Comms, Media and regional teams to make decisions and deliver on time. Partner with Product Marketing and Growth when a campaign depends on product claims or activation. - Set campaign goals and a practical measurement plan up front, then use brand and channel results to improve the next round of work. - Manage campaign resources,external partners, budgets and production dependencies within agreed authority; make clear trade-offs and build forward plans that account for creative lead times and local market conditions. WHAT YOU BRING - 12+ years of technology marketing experience across Brazil and Spanish-speaking LATAM. You’ve led major tech consumer brand campaigns and ongoing integrated marketing programs from brief through results. - Deep knowledge of LATAM consumers, culture and media, and the ability to turn that knowledge into a clear strategic choice. - Strong creative judgment and experience leading the briefing, concept review and production process with internal teams and agencies. - A record of bringing a compelling consumer product idea to life through brand strategy, local insight and distinctive creative work. - Experience developing channel plans across paid, owned and earned media, social, creators, partnerships or experiences. - Comfort defining brand and campaign success, interpreting measurement with specialist partners and turning results into practical decisions. - Experience balancing regional consistency with local nuance, and influencing cross-functional and global teams without relying on formal authority. - A clear record of personal ownership and autonomy: you can set direction, produce high-quality work directly, manage external partners, delivery, and make progress with incomplete inputs and limited resources. - Professional fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish is a plus. NICE TO HAVE - An established network of local creative, media, creator or cultural partners. - Prior experience marketing AI products, genuine curiosity about how people use AI, and enthusiasm for using it in your own daily life. items.title: Growth GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations
items.location_text: San Francisco, Austin, New York City
items.description: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. Millions of people and teams adopt Perplexity and Computer on their own, and our marketing programs bring in thousands more leads. To turn that demand into pipeline, every lead has to be enriched, scored, and routed to the right next step within minutes. We're hiring a Growth GTM Engineer on the Revenue Operations team to own the lead-to-engagement engine. You'll orchestrate enrichment across marketing and product leads. You'll build the scoring models that combine firmographic and technographic fit with demonstrated intent and product behavior. You'll own the routing that sends each lead back to Marketing for nurture or to BDRs and Sales for engagement. And you'll help build the custom internal apps our reps use to research, prioritize and engage prospects. You'll report to the Head of Marketing Operations, who sets the priorities for this work and owns our marketing automation platform, campaigns and attribution. You'll write production code, own the data and logic between our warehouse and Salesforce, and measure everything you build against meetings, pipeline and revenue. Tech stack: Salesforce | Snowflake | dbt | Python | TypeScript | Clay | Reverse ETL (Hightouch or similar) | Routing and scheduling (Default, Chili Piper or similar) | LLM APIs WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own enrichment orchestration. Design and run waterfall enrichment across third-party data providers, AI research agents and first-party data for every marketing and product lead. Handle lead-to-account matching, deduplication, field governance, data freshness and provider cost, so every record is complete, accurate and ready to act on. - Own and iterate on lead and account scoring. Build fit models from firmographic and technographic attributes such as industry, size, region, tech stack, AI maturity and buying-committee coverage. Combine them with intent and behavior signals: web and content engagement, email and campaign engagement from Marketing Operations, third-party intent, event activity, and product usage signals from the Growth team. Calibrate the models against closed-won and closed-lost data, version them, and explain to Sales why a lead scored the way it did. - Own lead routing. Design the decision logic that sends each lead to Marketing for nurture or to a BDR, AE or Account Manager for engagement, based on score, segment, territory, account ownership, capacity and existing opportunities. Co-define lifecycle stages, handoff SLAs, recycle rules and speed-to-lead triggers with the Head of Marketing Operations, and enforce them in Salesforce and our routing tools. - Close the feedback loop. Instrument the funnel from lead creation to MQL, meeting, opportunity and closed-won. Find where leads stall, which sources and signals predict pipeline, and whether our qualification criteria still hold, then send those insights back into scoring, routing and Marketing programs. Supply the data behind attribution, which the Head of Marketing Operations owns. - Help build custom internal apps for prospect engagement. Ship the tools reps use every day, such as account and prospect research briefs, signal-triggered alerts in Slack and Salesforce, prioritized call and outreach queues, and LLM-powered agents that draft personalized outreach and prepare reps before first touch. Run them like products: talk to users, track adoption and retire what doesn't get used. These apps are part of our BDR prospecting toolset, a combination of internal builds and vendor solutions that the Head of Marketing Operations owns or co-owns. Deliver against that roadmap, including integrating vendor tools with Salesforce and our data layer. - Be the technical owner of the lead data layer. Build and maintain the dbt models, reverse ETL syncs, APIs and webhooks that connect Snowflake, Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment providers and engagement tools. Make sure data flows are observable, tested and trusted. Support the rollout of our first marketing automation platform by building the Salesforce and warehouse side of its sync. - Partner across the business. Work with Marketing, Growth, BDR and Sales leadership, Data Science and Sales Systems to turn messy processes into durable systems. Work with the Growth team, using the PLG signals they publish to drive scoring and routing. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In your first 30 days: - Audit the current enrichment coverage, scoring logic, routing rules and lead SLAs, and document the gaps that cost us pipeline. In your first 90 days: - Ship an enrichment waterfall with measurable gains in fill rate and accuracy. - Ship an evolution of our unified scoring model that combines fit, intent and product signals, with a published rubric Sales trusts. - Ship routing that sends every lead to nurture or sales within an agreed SLA, with dashboards that show speed to lead and conversion by route. In your first 6 months: - Ship at least one rep-facing engagement app or agent with sustained weekly use by BDRs and AEs. - Show a measurable lift in MQL-to-meeting and meeting-to-opportunity conversion. QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years in GTM engineering, RevOps or Marketing Ops engineering, growth engineering, or data engineering in a B2B SaaS environment, including at least 2 years building enrichment, scoring or routing systems. - Commercial instinct. You start from a revenue problem, like "inbound enterprise leads wait too long for a first touch," and work back to the data, logic or tool that fixes it. - Strong SQL and experience building data models in a warehouse (Snowflake, dbt or similar). You pull your own data. - Production code in Python or TypeScript. items.title: Partner Director, IBM North America
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work cross-functionally across Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success to translate strategic partnerships into measurable outcomes for customers. Global systems integrators and technology services partners help enterprises move from AI strategy to production deployment. This role will lead OpenAI’s co-sell initiatives with IBM across North America, bringing together IBM’s consulting, technology, industry, and delivery capabilities with OpenAI’s products and platform. You will turn the global partnership strategy into a focused North America sales plan and repeatable field execution that delivers customer and commercial impact. About the Role We are hiring a Partner Sales Director to own IBM’s North America co-sell execution and measurable contribution to OpenAI growth. You will translate the global IBM partnership strategy into a prioritized regional business plan, activate IBM and OpenAI account teams, and drive qualified pipeline, closed business and sustained production adoption in partnership with sales, technical and delivery leaders. The role owns North America account prioritization, field activation, pursuit orchestration and partner forecasting within the global plan. Global partnership strategy, cross-region programs and commercial frameworks remain with global leadership; customer account ownership remains with the relevant OpenAI sales teams. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will connect senior executive engagement with joint account planning, co-selling, solution and delivery alignment, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. Success requires a strong understanding of how a large, matrixed services and technology organization operates, commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align teams without formal authority. The ideal candidate has led a high-impact partnership with IBM, built measurable pipeline and customer outcomes across North America, and knows how to turn partnership GTM strategy into account-level execution and successful deployments. In this role, you will: - Own North America partner sales and GTM with IBM, including regional strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery-readiness coordination and escalation, and long-term expansion, in alignment with the global alliance. - Develop and execute a North America joint business plan with clear account and industry priorities, investments, decision rights, milestones, and measures of success. - Build trusted relationships across IBM Consulting, IBM Technology, North America industry and regional leadership, alliance teams, client account leaders, sales organizations, architects, and delivery leaders, while staying aligned with global stakeholders. - Translate executive priorities into repeatable field execution spanning account mapping, opportunity qualification, co-selling, solution development, technical engagement, delivery handoffs, and escalation. - Shape joint solutions and industry plays that combine OpenAI capabilities with IBM’s consulting, technology, hybrid cloud, data, security, governance, and delivery strengths. - Lead joint account planning and strategic customer pursuits with IBM and OpenAI field teams across North America, with particular focus on complex and regulated enterprises. - Create a clear engagement model for OpenAI sellers and technical teams, including when to involve IBM, how opportunities are qualified, who owns each step, and how channel conflict is resolved. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Security, Legal, Finance, and Commercial teams to support complex customer engagements and remove technical, contractual, compliance, and operational blockers. - Build IBM’s North America field and delivery readiness through executive sponsorship, sales enablement, technical training, reusable solution patterns, and disciplined delivery handoffs. - Establish regional governance across executive business reviews, pipeline inspection, forecasting, milestone tracking, performance reporting, and escalation, connected to the global alliance operating model. - Own and track agreed North America commercial targets across qualified partner-sourced and co-sell pipeline, conversion to closed business, OpenAI revenue or consumption, and production adoption, with clear attribution and no double counting. - Align resource priorities with OpenAI sales and technical leaders for North America opportunities with the greatest strategic value, commercial potential, customer impact, delivery readiness, and repeatability. - Represent OpenAI in senior partner, customer, and industry engagements with clarity, sound judgment, and strong executive presence. - Build the regional operating model and identify the team capacity needed to scale the IBM partnership across North America. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Significant experience leading strategic alliances, GSI, or advisory partnerships, ecosystem sales, business development, or enterprise go-to-market programs in AI, cloud, data, SaaS, or enterprise technology. - Direct experience working with IBM and deep familiarity with its North America organization, consulting and technology businesses, incentives, decision-making networks, commercial model, and enterprise delivery motions. - A proven record of turning a strategic partnership into a qualified pipeline, closed business and production adoption, with clear evidence of your contribution to the commercial results. - Experience designing and scaling joint operating models across large, matrixed organizations, including governance, account planning, incentives, staffing, delivery handoffs, and escalation. - Demonstrated success shaping and advancing complex C-suite enterprise transformation opportunities from strategy through production deployment. - Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility with senior IBM and customer leaders while remaining close to operating details. - Commercial judgment and experience prioritizing investments, qualifying opportunities, managing forecasts, and making clear tradeoffs. - Technical fluency across enterprise AI, cloud and hybrid environments, data platforms, integration, security, governance, risk, and modern application architectures. - Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to align Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Operations without direct authority. - Experience building partner enablement, joint solutions, industry plays, and scalable field engagement models across North America. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure, accountability, and momentum in a rapidly evolving market. - Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills. - A builder mindset, high ownership, low ego, and a consistent focus on customer value and responsible AI adoption. What success looks like - OpenAI and IBM have a clear North America growth strategy, differentiated joint value proposition, executive governance model, and measurable business plan aligned with the global alliance. - IBM and OpenAI field teams across North America know when and how to engage one another, and qualified opportunities progress through a consistent co-sell and delivery motion. - The North America partnership generates qualified pipeline and converts priority opportunities into secure, successful production deployments with demonstrable customer value. - Joint solution patterns and industry plays become repeatable rather than remaining bespoke. - OpenAI resources are allocated transparently toward the highest-impact opportunities. - IBM’s North America teams demonstrate growing readiness and accountability across selling, architecture, implementation, and customer success. - The North America partnership earns sustained executive sponsorship and delivers measurable year-over-year growth. You will turn customer needs, product capabilities and advertiser success stories into compelling content—from webinars and educational video series to case studies, industry-specific playbooks and creator-led programs. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're hiring a Customer Marketing, Startups Lead to own our strategy for how Anthropic shows up in market with the startups building on Claude, from early-stage founders to our largest AI-native customers. You'll figure out how we can help startups grow, and find creative ways to amplify their stories to inspire more companies to do the same. This is a role for someone who has led marketing at a startup and knows what founders need. You'll work closely with our Startups account teams to decide where co-marketing will create real value for both the startup and Anthropic. For the startups we prioritize together, you'll work directly with founders and their teams as a marketing partner on channels and the joint messages we take to market. Many of these companies don't have big marketing teams yet, so you'll also advise them on storytelling and growth. This role is deeply cross-functional. You'll work with Startups Sales leadership, Startup Partnerships, Segment Marketing, Field Marketing, Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Comms, and Legal. You'll set direction with senior leaders here and at our customers, and lead a team of startups customer marketers while staying hands-on in the work yourself. Key responsibilities Own startups co-marketing, including deciding which startups and moments are worth investing in Be a marketing partner to founders and CEOs on channels and joint messaging, and advise companies without built-out marketing teams on storytelling and growth Partner with Startups Sales leadership and embed in the deal flow so you can see deals coming and plan how co-marketing can support them Work with account teams on the market development funds (MDF) in startup contracts, and own how those funds are deployed Build programs that bring co-marketing to hundreds of startups, beyond our top accounts Set the bar for startup storytelling and find creative ways to amplify those stories, from case studies and founder films to content on how startups use Claude Find opportunities to bring startups into Anthropic's launches and campaigns Work with Startup Partnerships and Segment Marketing on the Claude Startups program and our relationships with VCs and accelerators Build a feedback loop that shares what founders care about with Anthropic's leadership and GTM teams Lead and develop a team of startups customer marketers Minimum qualifications Have been a trusted advisor to founders and CEOs, and enjoy working closely with them Know when co-marketing will create real value for both companies, and when it won't Are a strong storyteller and writer who can tell what makes a founder's story worth telling Have a deep read on what startups want, and can quickly see what will help a small marketing team most Have led senior cross-functional work across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Comms Can influence teams you don't own, and are comfortable presenting to executives Have strong taste and judgment, and can say no, including to senior leaders Are a player-coach, comfortable setting direction for a team and doing the hands-on work yourself Are comfortable with technical products and can talk credibly with technical founders Can keep up with a fast pace Already use Claude in your own work Care about Anthropic's mission Preferred qualifications Have 12+ years in B2B marketing, including senior marketing leadership at a startup, like CMO, VP of Marketing, or Head of Marketing Been a founder or an early marketing hire at a startup Worked in AI, developer tools, or another technical category Worked at a company that sells to startups Built relationships with VCs and accelerators A network of founders and startup marketing leaders Run co-marketing programs with real budget behind them Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York offices at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $400,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Power Generation Design Engineer, Electrical & Mechanical
items.description: About the Team OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. The Data Center Engineering team defines repeatable technical standards and carries them through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness. The team works across data center facilities, power generation, compute infrastructure, construction, procurement, and operations to deliver reliable capacity at unprecedented scale and speed. About the Role We are seeking a Power Generation Design Engineer to help design and integrate generation plants and balance-of-plant systems for large AI data center campuses. This role spans electrical and mechanical systems, including generation equipment, campus and grid interfaces, fuel and auxiliary systems, cooling, controls, and data center loads. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in either electrical or mechanical engineering, along with the cross-disciplinary judgment to evaluate how the full plant operates as an integrated system. items.title: Lead Product Designer, Growth (Mobile)
items.description: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We’ve scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action. ABOUT THE ROLE Perplexity is looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to own mobile design for Growth. You'll shape the experiences that bring Perplexity to as many people as possible on the device they reach for first, making software that feels like the future but can be understood and used by anyone in the world today. Growth design has its own craft and nuance, and so does mobile. You'll own the highest-leverage moments in the mobile user journey: first-run onboarding and activation, consumer acquisition surfaces, conversion flows, paywalls and pricing, the nudges and upsells that drive adoption of new products and features, and the retention loops that turn first-time users into daily ones. This is design where a few pixels, a single step, or the timing of a transition can move real numbers, so you'll pair a high craft bar with rigorous experimentation, letting real data guide the work. You'll do that in the real material: prototyping on device, writing SwiftUI in Xcode, and putting up your own PRs. You care about clarity, craft, details, and delight as much as you care about growth and impact. This role is deeply cross-functional: you'll partner closely with our Growth, Product Marketing, mobile engineering, and brand design teams, and you care about everything it takes to make a product great: product, interaction, growth, copywriting, engineering, and marketing. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead mobile product design for Growth across the full lifecycle: acquisition, activation, retention, monetization, and enterprise expansion - Design first-run and onboarding experiences that feel native to the platform and get users to value as fast as possible - Craft conversion and upsell flows for mobile, including paywalls, pricing, and plan comparison - Design growth experiences for an AI-native product, getting people to their first great answer fast and helping them discover new capabilities like Computer - Bring the Perplexity brand to life in our growth surfaces through cinematic motion, visual design, and interaction detail - Prototype on device early and often, using real code to answer questions static mocks can't - Write SwiftUI and put up your own PRs, working alongside mobile engineers to close the gap between the design and what ships - Partner closely with Growth and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, and funnel strategy - Design and run experiments, using data and real usage to drive decisions and measure impact - Explore what new platform capabilities and form factors make possible for growth - Think about how to go from 0→1 but also how to make your decisions scale well - Contribute to process so we're always shipping changes you're proud of, as often as possible WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Experience designing consumer or prosumer products, with a strong track record of shipping native mobile apps - Deep fluency in iOS: platform conventions, navigation patterns, gestures, system components, and what's new each year - A solid understanding of growth nuances: onboarding, activation, acquisition, conversion, upsells, paywalls, pricing, and retention - A data-informed approach, fluent in experimentation, funnels, and metrics, and comfortable learning from usage - Excellent visual, UI, interaction, and motion skills, with a knack for bringing a brand to life in product without getting in the way of use - Comfort prototyping on device, working in Xcode with SwiftUI, and putting up your own PRs in a production codebase - An excellent communicator who can tell a clear story from data and design rationale to team members and leadership - You care about shipping great software more than anything else - Comfort with a high level of autonomy and ambiguity, and the craft to be seen as a peer lead by the rest of the design team - 5+ years of industry experience NICE TO HAVE - Experience designing for Android or working in Jetpack Compose (we design iOS-first, but Android is in scope) - Fluency with motion tools such as Rive, Lottie, or After Effects - You've already been exploring or prototyping interactions for foldables like iPhone Duo NOTES FOR CANDIDATES - Please submit your portfolio with your application.

We work cross-functionally across Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success to translate strategic partnerships into measurable outcomes for customers. Global advisory and consulting partners help enterprises move from AI strategy to production deployment. This role will lead OpenAI’s partnership with EY across North America, bringing together EY’s industry, business transformation, technology consulting, and delivery expertise with OpenAI’s products and capabilities. You will turn the global alliance strategy into a focused North America business plan and repeatable field execution that delivers customer and commercial impact. About the Role We are hiring a Partner Director, EY North America to lead OpenAI’s partner business with EY across the region. You will own North America joint business plan, build executive alignment, and activate EY and OpenAI field teams to generate qualified pipeline, win strategic opportunities, and drive successful production adoption. You will align regional priorities and execution with the global EY alliance strategy. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will connect senior executive engagement with joint account planning, co-selling, solution and delivery alignment, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. Success requires a strong understanding of how a large, partner-led professional services organization operates, commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align teams without formal authority. The ideal candidate has led a high-impact partnership with EY, built measurable pipeline and customer outcomes across North America, and knows how to turn alliance strategy into account-level execution and successful deployments. In this role, you will: - Own North America partnership with EY, including regional strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery quality, and long-term expansion, in alignment with the global alliance. - Develop and execute a North America joint business plan with clear account and industry priorities, investments, decision rights, milestones, and measures of success. - Build trusted relationships with EY’s North America leadership, senior partners, industry and consulting practice leaders, alliance teams, client account leaders, technical teams, and delivery leaders, while staying aligned with global stakeholders. - Represent OpenAI in senior partner, customer, and industry engagements with clarity, sound judgment, and strong executive presence. - Build the regional operating model and identify the team capacity needed to scale the EY partnership across North America. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Significant experience leading strategic alliances, GSI, or advisory partnerships, ecosystem sales, business development, or enterprise go-to-market programs in AI, cloud, data, SaaS, or enterprise technology. - A builder mindset, high ownership, low ego, and a consistent focus on customer value and responsible AI adoption. The team is responsible for building the next generation of AI-native silicon while working closely with software and research partners to co-design hardware tightly integrated with AI models. You’ll work alongside experts in thermal, mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineering to support the design, analysis, and validation of thermal solutions that ensure the reliability, efficiency, and longevity of mission-critical hardware. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. The Legal team helps Robinhood build and launch products while meeting the rules that apply to a regulated financial company. Our attorneys work alongside Product, Engineering, Compliance and business leaders, giving clear, practical advice on questions that range from new product launches to regulatory matters. We value sound judgment, plain-spoken advice, and a bias toward helping the business move forward the right way. Robinhood is looking for an Assistant General Counsel to join our growing Regulatory legal team. We are looking for a highly adaptable and collaborative person who can handle ambiguity and rapidly shifting priorities with flexibility and patience.
