items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Claude Partner Network is how partners build, sell, and deliver on Claude. Partner Support keeps them moving: getting set up, getting certified, registering their work, and understanding where they stand in the program. It runs in layers. Self-serve and an AI support agent handle what they can, an outsourced vendor team works the in-scope (L1) topics, and our specialists take the escalated (L2) cases that need judgment. As our Partner Support Operations Lead, you will run partner support end to end: the team, the operating model, and the systems behind every layer. Partner Programs sets program policy. You will build and run the service levels, knowledge, quality bar, and escalation paths that put that policy into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows. This is a hands-on operator and builder role. You will be close enough to the queue to know why a case was hard or a rule broke, while you build the team, the vendor coverage, and the Claude-powered automation that keep support from growing in line with partner count. Key responsibilities Manage the partner support team: set priorities and clear expectations, coach the Partner Support Specialists, address performance early, and expand the team if volume or coverage calls for it Own the support operating model: the L1 and L2 boundary, severity definitions, service levels, and escalation paths; review misrouted and wrongly escalated tickets, and fix the rule as well as the ticket Run the L2 queue to its service levels: coverage across shifts, one owner for every case, clean handoffs to the teams that hold the answer, and careful handling of sensitive and high-impact partner issues Manage the support service line with our business process outsourcing (BPO) team: work with their leads day to day and hold a stated quality bar through training and sign-off for each new cohort, the QA rubric and calibration, the weekly operating review, and corrective action when quality or coverage slips Own the knowledge layer: one source of truth for the help center, macros, and AI agent content, updated when a program change ships, so every layer gives partners the same answer from day one of a launch Own the support platform: routing, conversation attributes, views, workflows, access, and service-level reporting; keep the taxonomy short, consistent, and reportable Scale through self-serve, vendors, and Claude: use topic and outcome data to decide what moves to each, and build automations for tagging, routing, QA screening, and reporting; test them on real tickets and add human checkpoints where a wrong answer carries risk Turn what partners ask into fixes: bring the recurring causes behind ticket volume to Partner Programs, Partner Business Systems, and other owners, and follow each one through until the tickets stop Run support on a scorecard covering responsiveness, resolution, escalation accuracy, and quality, and use it to plan capacity and to tell the team, the vendor, and leadership what to fix next Minimum qualifications Support operations experience at a technology company, including managing a small team Experience running an outsourced or BPO support team: onboarding waves, service levels, QA rubrics, calibration, and performance feedback A track record of building a tiered support model from an early stage and running it as volume grew Hands-on depth in Intercom or a comparable platform (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud): routing rules, attributes, workflows, reporting, and permissions Experience running knowledge and content for an AI support agent, including how to review answer quality and close content gaps Strong analytical instincts: able to read ticket data, find the cause behind a spike or a backlog, and turn it into a fix and a capacity plan Sound judgment while the program is still moving: able to make the call with incomplete information, hold a policy line with a frustrated partner or an internal stakeholder, and keep the relationship intact A builder's mindset and clear writing: you use tools like Claude to automate your own work, and you document what you build so a new teammate or vendor lead can run it Preferred qualifications Support operations experience in a B2B, partner, or channel environment Experience supporting a partner, reseller, systems integrator, or independent software vendor (ISV) program Experience building support coverage across regions, time zones, or languages Familiarity with Salesforce, and with the Claude API, Claude Code, or MCP The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: About the Role We’re looking for a hands-on sales program manager to build and scale new revenue programs across OpenAI’s global SMB sales teams. Your first focus will be outbound: designing acquisition plays, launching pilots and turning what works into repeatable programs. You’ll combine sales judgment, program management and the ability to drive execution through other teams. Working closely with regional vendor managers, frontline leaders, Enablement, RevOps and product and pricing partners, you’ll bring clarity to what we’re launching, how sellers should execute and how we’ll measure success. In this role, you will: - Build and roll out sales plays: define the audience, targeting, messaging, outreach, qualification and handoff, then work with vendor teams and Enablement to get sellers ready. - Own pilot performance: agree goals and a baseline, review results, diagnose gaps and recommend what to scale, improve or stop. Measure qualified pipeline, conversion and revenue as pilots mature, alongside seller productivity. - Drive execution through teams: coordinate regional vendor managers and vendor leaders, establish clear owners and milestones, and resolve blockers without taking over day-to-day team management. - Bring cross-functional clarity: work with product, pricing, RevOps and Enablement partners to explain changes, assess their impact on programs and translate them into practical seller guidance. - Build with AI for scale: develop repeatable workflows for account research, seller preparation, quality checks and reporting. Validate quality before expanding adoption. - Make successful programs repeatable: document simple playbooks, adapt them across regions and use frontline feedback to keep improving. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 3-6 years directly managing sales programs or leading a sales team in a fast-paced tech, fintech, startup or comparable environment. - Hands-on outbound, SDR or acquisition program experience, with clear examples of what you built, how you measured performance and what improved. - Strong program management: the ability to turn an ambiguous goal into a practical plan, align teams and follow through on delivery. - Commercial and analytical judgment: the ability to diagnose funnel performance and distinguish activity from meaningful pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Confidence working across sales, operations and product partners, bringing clarity to decisions and translating complexity into simple actions. - Practical experience using AI to improve workflows and scale execution while maintaining quality. - Experience managing vendors or outsourced sales teams is a plus, not a requirement. items.title: Partner Sales & Development Leader
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organizations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes. Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption. About the Role We are hiring a Partner Sales & Development Manager to lead our partner sales and development team for either the South & East or North & West region of North America. Reporting to the North America Co-Sell Leader, you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption. This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value. You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus. In this role, you will: - Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region—South & East or North & West—aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership and the North America Co-Sell Leader. - Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance. - Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution. - Lead account mapping and joint account planning with OpenAI sellers and partner teams to identify whitespace, qualify opportunities, and prioritize the accounts and use cases with the greatest potential. - Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans. - Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy. - Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and partner delivery teams to address technical and implementation dependencies and help customers deploy, adopt, and expand AI workloads in production. - Create repeatable field engagement models, partner enablement, sales plays, and escalation paths that make it easier for OpenAI and partner teams to work together effectively. - Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood’s Customer Experience team plays a critical role in Democratizing Finance for All. Our customer experience team supports customers across a wide range of account needs, delivering timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple channels. As a Customer Experience Team Lead, you will help lead a team of customer support representatives responsible for delivering high-quality service and resolving customer issues efficiently. You will coach and develop team members focusing on technical coaching and driving subject matter expertise. You’ll support the Customer Experience Manager to ensure operational excellence, and act as a point of contact for escalations and complex customer situations. In this role, you will help drive performance through coaching, quality standards, and service-level accountability while partnering with operations, quality assurance, and compliance teams to continuously improve the customer experience. The Money (Credit and Banking) team supports our customers as they utilize Robinhood’s growing suite of banking and credit features. As the Money Team Lead, you will lead a newly growing desk focused on banking, credit, and money movement. You will play a crucial role in building the foundation of this team, navigating changes as this business area scales rapidly. Schedule & Work Environment This role is based in our Westlake, TX office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days a week. The team operates on a 7:00am - 9:00pm EST. Employees will work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts per week, depending on business needs. Specific schedules will be determined after hire. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + benefits. Our mission is to help customers successfully adopt and operationalize AI across their organizations. By helping customers move from experimentation to production, the ADM team accelerates time-to-value, deepens product adoption, and helps make OpenAI indispensable to how organizations work. This role is responsible for designing and delivering enablement experiences that support a repeatable adoption framework, driving sustained activation, expanding breadth and depth of usage, and measurable business value across OpenAI’s product suite, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents. This role blends strong product fluency, instructional design, and customer advisory. You will lead live workshops, deliver services, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from everyday business users to technical practitioners and executive leaders, helping customers understand not just what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them effectively in real world workflows. items.title: Resale Operations Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Resellers are a major route for organizations to buy Claude. Our reseller program runs across two motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems. Each motion brings its own agreements, systems and cloud counterparts, and the program is expanding across regions at the same time. As our Resale Operations Lead, you will run resale operations: how resellers get authorized, transact, get reported on, get paid and get supported, across both motions and every live cloud. The resale business team sets the strategy and the commercial framework. You will build and run the processes, playbooks and team that put that framework into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows. This is an operator and builder role, not a partner manager role. You will be hands-on in the detail of a private offer or a partner quote while you build the team, the vendor coverage and the Claude-powered automation that keep resale operations from growing in line with partner count. Reporting to Head of Partner Operations and Systems · San Francisco or New York based What you'll do Lead the resale operations team: set priorities, coach the reseller operations managers, and keep every region on the same playbooks rather than a set of local processes. Build the resale runbook and launch kit across AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, so that authorizing, onboarding and supporting a reseller works the same way wherever it can, and each new cloud comes online from the kit. Run hyperscaler resale operations: marketplace authorizations and private-offer processing with the cloud alliance teams, and operational escalations with AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, raised through the cloud alliance teams. Stand up direct resale operations: partner quotes in Salesforce CPQ, order forms, booking and provisioning, and commit tracking and true-ups, working with Deal Desk, Commercial Operations, Finance and Tax. Operate the program rules as controls that can actually run: deal registration to the published policy, eligibility checks, margin and rebate data, and the unauthorized resale process. Flag early what cannot be operated yet. Own the reseller transaction data, so that every reseller transaction traces to an end customer under the attribution rules Partner Strategy and Operations governs, partners are paid accurately and partner-sourced revenue can be measured. Scale through vendors and Claude: propose which resale work moves to outsourced teams or to Claude, run the vendor team's resale scope to a stated quality bar, and build automations with human checkpoints where a wrong decision carries risk. Run resale on a scorecard: application decision time, registration cycle time, attribution coverage, payout accuracy and launch readiness. Use it to tell the team and leadership what to fix next. What might make you a good fit Channel, reseller, distribution or partner operations experience at a technology company, including managing a small team. Hands-on depth in both motions: cloud marketplace resale (authorizations, private offers, deal registration) and direct or contract-based resale (quote-to-order, partner billing). A track record of building a resale or channel operations process from an early stage and running it as volume grew. Fluency in order-to-cash, including Salesforce CPQ or a comparable tool and the Finance, Deal Desk, Legal and Tax coordination that comes with it. Experience managing outsourced or vendor teams: scope, service levels, quality sampling and performance feedback. Sound judgment while the program is still moving. You can make the call with incomplete information, hold a control under pressure from sales or a partner, and keep the relationship intact. A builder's mindset and clear writing. You use tools like Claude to automate your own work, and you document what you build so a new teammate or vendor lead can run it. Strong candidates may also have Experience on the partner or marketplace side of a hyperscaler, or in operations at a major distributor. Experience running partner rebate, margin or incentive operations, or launching a resale program in EMEA or APAC. Familiarity with the Claude API, Claude Code or MCP. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $215,000 — $300,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. items.title: AML Investigator
items.location_text: Denver, CO; New York, NY; Westlake, TX
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Financial Crimes Investigations team protects Robinhood and its customers by detecting, investigating, and reporting potentially suspicious activity across our brokerage and crypto products. The team partners closely with Compliance, Legal, Product, Risk, and Engineering to strengthen controls and meet regulatory obligations. We focus on thorough investigations, clear documentation, and continuous process improvement to reduce financial crime risk. Our work directly supports regulatory compliance and customer trust. As an AML Investigator, you will conduct complex investigations involving cryptocurrency transactions, brokerage accounts, and cash movement. You will analyze blockchain activity using industry-standard analytics tools, evaluate customer behavior across Robinhood entities, and prepare Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory requirements. You will manage investigations from initial alert through final decision and documentation, while identifying trends and control enhancements that strengthen our monitoring program. Your analysis will contribute directly to meeting Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and anti-money laundering (AML) obligations. This role is based in our New York, NY; Denver, CO; or Westlake, TX office(s)office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least [3/4/5] days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Conduct investigations into potentially suspicious activity across cryptocurrency products, brokerage accounts, and fiat transactions generated from transaction monitoring systems, referrals, or external inquiries. Analyze blockchain transactions using tools such as Chainalysis, TRM, or similar platforms to trace fund flows and identify indicators of money laundering or other financial crimes. Review customer activity across Robinhood Financial, Robinhood Securities, Robinhood Crypto, and Robinhood Money to assess risk and determine appropriate case outcomes. Draft clear, well-supported Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory standards and internal quality benchmarks. Manage the full lifecycle of investigations, including alert review, evidence gathering, decisioning, documentation, and case closure. Contribute to process improvements by identifying trends, control gaps, or tooling enhancements that improve investigative quality and efficiency. What you bring 2+ years of AML investigation experience within a broker-dealer, cryptocurrency firm, fintech company, or financial institution, including SAR drafting. Hands-on experience analyzing cryptocurrency transactions and using blockchain analytics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM, or similar tools). Preference for those with course certifications from Chainalysis or TRM Experience working across both fiat and crypto product environments Strong understanding of BSA/AML regulatory requirements, particularly as they relate to virtual currencies and digital asset platforms. Ability to evaluate large data sets, document findings clearly, and make defensible risk-based decisions. Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preference for those with ACAMS certification or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.title: Federal Account Director, Intelligence Community
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their organization. The team comprises Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals who collaborate to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the Role Our Government Sales team has a unique mission to help the U.S. Intelligence Community understand the transformative impact that highly capable AI models can bring to its most critical missions. This role combines technical understanding, strategic vision, relationship management, and value-driven sales strategy tailored specifically to Intelligence Community customers. You’ll drive key opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation through deployment and expansion. You’ll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, solution strategists, and cross-functional partners to help Intelligence Community customers advance their missions through AI. This role is based in Washington, D.C. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In addition, this role requires frequent on-site engagement at customer and partner facilities across the Washington, D.C./Northern Virginia corridor, including classified environments. In this role, you will: - Manage a focused set of key U.S. Intelligence Community accounts, developing and executing comprehensive account strategies. - Lead Intelligence Community customers through their AI adoption journey, from initial consideration through successful deployment and expansion. - Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, mission owners, technical stakeholders, acquisition professionals, and other decision-makers across the Intelligence Community. - Partner with Solutions and Research Engineering teams to design and execute complex customer programs and deployments. - Develop and execute capture and co-sell strategies with federal systems integrators and specialized mission partners to position OpenAI in multi-year programs of record. - Align opportunity planning and deal strategy to MIP and NIP funding cycles, classified contract vehicles, appropriations timing, and extended approval chains. - Work with cleared technical teams to demonstrate value across cloud, hybrid, on-premises, and air-gapped environments and translate technical fit into mission outcomes. - Own and manage an Intelligence Community consumption revenue target. - Develop pipeline, lead complex deal strategies, and drive opportunities through the full sales cycle. - Oversee revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and account reporting. - Analyze account performance and provide actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders. - Closely monitor Intelligence Community priorities, policies, acquisition trends, competitors, and partners to inform product roadmaps and company strategy. - Navigate complex security, compliance, procurement, and contracting requirements associated with Intelligence Community customers. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions, Product, Engineering, Government Affairs, Marketing, Communications, Business Operations, People Operations, Finance, and Legal. - Support the recruitment and onboarding of team members focused on the Intelligence Community. - Help build and strengthen OpenAI’s culture and operating model within the Intelligence Community practice. We're seeking someone with experience including: - 10+ years selling commercial technology, including platform-as-a-service, software-as-a-service, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or other enterprise technology, to the U.S. Intelligence Community. - A documented track record of closing high-value, multi-stakeholder enterprise technology deals across major Intelligence Community organizations and their supporting ecosystems. - An active Top Secret clearance with Full Scope Polygraph. - Developing and executing complex account and deal strategies within the Intelligence Community. - Navigating Intelligence Community procurement, acquisition, contracting, security, and deployment processes. - Deep familiarity with MIP and NIP funding cycles, classified contract vehicles, multi-year programs of record, and extended acquisition timelines. - An established senior-level network of GS-15/SES/SIS and C-suite relationships across major Intelligence Community organizations and their supporting ecosystems. - Experience partnering with federal systems integrators and specialized mission partners on capture strategies, co-selling, and program expansion. - Proven experience selling cloud, cybersecurity, hybrid-cloud, or AI infrastructure into sensitive or classified environments, including on-premises and air-gapped deployment patterns. - Consistently delivering growth in fast-paced, high-performance environments. - Working directly with senior Intelligence Community executives, mission leaders, technical stakeholders, and decision-makers. - Deep relationships and native familiarity with Intelligence Community missions, organizational structures, workflows, and buying processes. - Translating technical capabilities into clear mission outcomes and strategic value. - Communicating technical and strategic concepts clearly to both Intelligence Community customers and internal stakeholders. - Leading high-visibility customer briefings, executive engagements, demonstrations, and industry events. - Gathering, distilling, and applying detailed market intelligence, including agency priorities, policy developments, budget trends, acquisition strategies, and competitor activity. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand defense customers’ priorities and help them achieve their mission-critical objectives using AI. You build trusted relationships with senior executives and stakeholders across defense and national security agencies. - Have a passion or deep curiosity about artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy OpenAI’s technology in ways that advance national security missions and benefit humanity. You’re enthusiastic about educating defense customers on AI capabilities and strategic implications. - Are a builder. You enjoy impacting how our company grows its defense and intelligence business. You excel in establishing robust systems and processes tailored to defense customer requirements, executing them with precision and agility. - Are excited by new challenges. You thrive when solving complex, mission-critical defense and national security problems. Bespoke challenges requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you, and you’re eager to experiment with innovative solutions within national security environments. - Are a strategist. You deeply understand defense go-to-market best practices and proactively contribute to strategic initiatives. You plan years ahead, effectively aligning internal and external defense and intelligence stakeholders to achieve long-term objectives. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets. - Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business. - Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys. - Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships. - Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. items.title: Sales Development Lead - North America
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Sales Development Lead to drive our growing SDR team to the next stage of maturity as an organization. You’ll be stepping into an exciting phase: we already have a strong foundation SDRs in place, new starters joining, and more hires planned as we continue to grow. This role is pivotal in shaping how we generate pipeline, break into new markets, and drive top-of-funnel excellence at ElevenLabs. You’ll bring creative and proactive outbound strategies, strategy to a high-velocity team, while working closely with Account Executives and sales leadership to fuel our ambitious growth targets. We are particularly interested in finding builders who can leverage the power of AI and automation to redefine the SDR role as it exists today. If you're a player-coach who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves building and developing talent, and gets energy from seeing your team win - we’d love to hear from you. In this role you will: - Lead a team of SDRs with plans for continued headcount growth - Foster go-to-market experimentation as we expand across customer segments and global markets - Inspire a team culture of curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement - Use data and tooling to continuously optimize strategy and supersede impact metrics - Establish and refine scalable processes for outbound prospecting, qualification, and AE handoff - Build onboarding, enablement, and coaching frameworks that set your team up for long-term success - Partner with Account Executives and sales leadership to align on pipeline targets and performance metrics REQUIREMENTS - 4+ years of experience in sales or business development, with at least 1–2 years in a management or team lead capacity - Proven excellence and deal closing experience - Relevant and recent experience in outbound prospecting, especially to technical and enterprise personas - Deep AI fluency and builder experience - Experience managing high-performing SDR or BDR teams in fast-growing tech environments - Skilled in sales metrics, CRM/reporting tools, and modern outreach techniques - Excellent coaching and communication skills — you're energized by developing others - Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you thrive in high-growth, rapidly changing environments Bonus: - Experience in early-stage or Series A–C startup environments - Exposure to voice tech, AI, developer tools, or creative platforms - Worked with globally distributed teams This role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere in the United States. The ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates based in San Francisco. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Support Technology
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help. We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can't or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners. Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product. Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn't unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that's the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask. As one of the team's early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person. This is a hands-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform. Key responsibilities Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem Make our support agents reliable first responders: Build the tools, APIs, and safe, audited workflows our Claude-powered support agents use for common fixes, with evals, guardrails, and clean handoffs to people, and measure whether customers' problems actually get solved Build the platform foundations: Create a reliable support platform that scales with our growth, including the experience and tools for customers and specialists, and the data that shows what customers are running into and whether our changes help Support enterprise and partner channels: Extend support to business customers, admins, and partner-sold customers, including cases that start outside our own products Raise the bar and build with Claude: Set standards for reliability, observability, testing, and rollouts, mentor engineers, and use Claude heavily in your own work Minimum qualifications Deep backend and distributed systems skills, including APIs, data models, event-driven systems, and third-party integrations Experience building production software, including technical lead roles on multi-team projects Experience building systems where correctness, access control, and auditability matter A clear vision for how capable models like Claude can improve customer support, and motivation to build it Judgment about when to ship a simple fix and when to invest in a platform Track record of leading without formal authority and getting other teams to own and ship fixes Preferred qualifications 8+ years building backend or platform systems in production, including 3+ years leading large-scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead Experience building and improving customer-facing products with measurable impact Experience with billing, payments, or subscription systems Experience shipping LLM-based or agentic systems in production Experience building with helpdesk or contact center platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, or Salesforce Service Cloud Experience building internal tools or platforms for operations teams such as support, risk, finance, or trust and safety Experience building data pipelines for support or operations analytics Full-stack experience, including web UIs for internal tools or customer-facing flows Experience with enterprise features such as SSO, admin controls, or provisioning, or with partner and cloud marketplace integrations Experience setting multi-year technical direction for an area and growing other senior engineers The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Solutions architect (UK)
items.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Every company grows differently, and at WRITER, our growth is directly tied to empowering our users to create better content, faster, and at an unprecedented scale. As a strategic solutions architect, you'll be at the forefront of this mission, working directly with our largest and most strategic prospects to identify, validate, and build innovative generative AI solutions that unlock massive business value. This isn't just about selling a product; it's about deeply understanding complex enterprise needs and architecting a future where AI transforms how our customers operate. You'll be instrumental in shaping how the world's leading companies adopt and scale AI, making a tangible impact on both their success and WRITER’s continued leadership in the enterprise generative AI space. This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our London hub. You will report directly to the Director of solutions architecture. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do - Drive strategic technical discovery with Fortune 500 prospects and customers, translating complex business challenges into clear, impactful technical solutions for AI-powered work - Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure generative AI solutions for enterprise clients, leveraging WRITER's platform, APIs, and custom applications to solve critical business problems - Lead the development and execution of compelling proofs of concept (PoCs) and demonstrations, building custom templates and integrating WRITER's capabilities to showcase transformative value and accelerate time-to-value for customers - Serve as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives, VPs of Engineering, and AI leaders, guiding their generative AI strategy and collaborating to define enterprise-level architecture roadmaps - Partner closely with WRITER's Product and Engineering teams, providing critical feedback from customer engagements to influence our product roadmap and ensure our solutions meet evolving market needs - Champion the adoption of WRITER's platform and APIs, educating prospects and partners on the art of the possible with generative AI and empowering them to build their own innovative solutions. ⭐️ What you need - 3+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as solutions architect, enterprise architect, or sales engineering, ideally within a high-growth, B2B SaaS company serving Fortune 500 clients - Deep expertise in generative AI principles, large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering best practices, with a passion for staying ahead of the curve in this rapidly evolving field - Experience in Python, proficiency with APIs, and end-to-end orchestration, to augment AI workflows and integrate AI capabilities into complex enterprise systems - Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to simplify complex technical concepts into clear, compelling business language for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership - A highly versatile and tenured problem solver, capable of leading multi-stakeholder discovery sessions, uncovering root causes, and architecting innovative solutions to complex business and technical challenges - A builder's mindset and a proven ability to Connect deeply with customer needs, Challenge the status quo with innovative AI solutions, and Own the technical success and impact of client engagements 🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees): - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Comprehensive medical and dental insurance - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Competitive pension scheme and company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation and company stock options

items.title: Threat Detection and Response Engineering Manager
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s mission depends on developing and deploying powerful AI responsibly. Security makes that possible by protecting our research, people, products, and users while enabling progress. We defend sensitive research and other intellectual property, customer data, and the infrastructure behind frontier AI—from GPU supercomputing and multicloud environments to datacenters and emerging agent systems. Threat Detection Engineering builds and operates the detections and investigative workflows that turn adversary activity into effective response. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to guide the engineers who identify and investigate threats to OpenAI and build the capabilities to contain them. You’ll hire and develop engineers, set technical direction, and prioritize risks to OpenAI’s intellectual property, customer data, and critical infrastructure. Your team will take an agent-first approach across the detection and response lifecycle, using OpenAI’s models to develop detections, triage signals, investigate suspicious activity, and support bounded response and continuous improvement. You’ll turn advances in model capability into dependable defenses, own their effectiveness, and work with security, research, and infrastructure partners to ensure findings lead to effective action. You’ll establish where agents can act independently and where human judgment and approval are essential. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Hire, coach, and develop engineers. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, grow technical leadership, and build a team that reviews work rigorously and learns from missed detections and noisy signals. - Set a threat-informed roadmap. Prioritize detection work based on how external and internal actors could target the systems where we train and evaluate frontier models, the production services that run inference and power our products worldwide, the datacenter hardware and networks that support both, and the devices, identities, and applications employees rely on. Balance investment in emerging threats with closing known coverage gaps and keeping existing detections effective. - Own detection and investigation as a complete workflow. Embed agent-driven triage and investigation in the detections your team operates. Surface findings when the evidence points to a likely threat that warrants action. When a finding warrants formal incident response, bring the evidence to the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) and support the investigation SIRT leads. - Build response and containment capabilities tailored to our infrastructure. Work with infrastructure and system owners to develop and test the controls responders need to contain threats in their environments. Define when human approval is required and how to verify that containment worked. - Apply models across the detection engineering lifecycle. Use OpenAI’s models to help develop threat hypotheses, author and test detections, deploy and tune them, and incorporate investigation findings into better coverage. Evaluate the effectiveness of individual agents and the complete workflows they support. - Turn model advances into tested defenses. Prototype new approaches using OpenAI’s models, evaluate them against realistic adversary behavior and analyst baselines, and move successful experiments into production. Use operational evidence to identify model limitations and partner with Research and Engineering to address them. - Anticipate emerging threats. Translate adversary intelligence and incident findings into testable detection hypotheses. Work with researchers and infrastructure owners on risks specific to a frontier AI lab, such as increasingly capable agents operating across systems with access to sensitive research. Determine what evidence would reveal compromise and what response would be effective. - Establish the visibility needed to detect, investigate, and respond. Partner with Security Observability and infrastructure owners to define telemetry and forensic data requirements. Drive improvements where missing evidence, unreliable data, or limited controls prevent the team from identifying threats or taking effective action. - Engineer for measurable security outcomes. Use replay, adversarial validation, and regression testing to assess whether workflows find intended threats, distinguish benign activity, and reach defensible conclusions. Establish code review, documentation, staged rollout, monitoring, and rollback practices. Measure coverage, investigation accuracy, time to identify threats, and effectiveness of response. - Contribute during incidents. The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) leads formal incident response. Your team contributes investigative expertise and uses incident findings to improve detections. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Think like an adversary and demand evidence as a defender. You question whether apparent coverage would survive a determined attacker, distinguish plausible explanations from supported conclusions, and stay accountable for threats that existing tools and playbooks miss. - Have managed security or software engineers and can demonstrate how you have hired, coached, developed technical judgment, and improved a team’s ability to deliver. - Are a hands-on builder who can prototype tools, write and review code, and guide engineers through complex detection, investigation, and response designs. - Bring strong AI fluency and have built systems that test how models or agents can improve cyber defense. You have evaluated real security workflows against meaningful baselines and can explain what improved, what failed, and what you changed. You understand model failure modes and design reliable workflows with bounded permissions and clear human decision points. - Have built or operated threat detections and led technical investigations. You understand adversary tradecraft and can assess evidence, scope, and uncertainty across complex environments. - Understand how identity, endpoint, cloud, Kubernetes, and infrastructure telemetry supports investigations. You can reason about response and containment in unfamiliar systems and work with their owners to build practical capabilities. - Have used testing and operational feedback to improve security outcomes. You can explain tradeoffs among coverage, accuracy, speed, and human workload, and choose measures that reflect whether threats are being found and addressed. - Can build a focused roadmap and strong cross-functional partnerships in a rapidly changing environment. You enable researchers and engineers to move quickly while following through on security requirements and dependable operations. items.title: Accounts Receivable Operations Analyst
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. We’re looking for a talented and energetic Accounts Receivable Operation Analyst to join our accounting operations team. You will interact and coordinate with colleagues in Accounting, Finance, Treasury, Tax and various other departments across Robinhood to meet daily operational needs. This position will be responsible for increasing efficiency by accurately processing all receivable transactions and meeting associated deadlines. The Accounts Receivable Analyst will gain exposure to the global, technical and operational receivable activities and have a high degree of commitment, independent, resourcefulness, and detail-oriented to achieve 100% accuracy. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY or Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Manage full-cycle billing operations, generating timely invoices and customer statements while maintaining accurate accounts receivable records. Drive end-to-end management of outstanding balances through rigorous account reconciliations, variance analysis, cash application, and proof-of-delivery validation. Achieve key AR performance metrics by proactively driving collections and managing resolution plans for delinquent accounts. Deliver high-touch, solutions-driven support to customers, cultivating strong relationships by resolving billing inquiries and payment discrepancies efficiently. Provide actionable updates and visibility to internal leadership regarding account statuses and resolution timelines. Contribute to the development and implementation of scalable AR processes, tools, and platforms to enhance operational productivity. Identify, evaluate, and integrate AI-driven automation tools to optimize cash application, invoice matching, and routine AR workflows. Operate with a high degree of ownership and urgency to consistently hit deadlines, manage ad-hoc initiatives, and deliver high-impact results. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 2–3 years of relevant AR experience in the tech industry or a comparable fast-paced, complex environment. Collaborative team player who builds strong cross-functional partnerships across the organization. Hands-on experience with Oracle ERP (or a comparable system). Highly organized, deadline-driven, and capable of processing and managing a high volume of transactions with strict accuracy. A professional who can work independently with minimal supervision and effectively manage their time to meet all deadlines. Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask, and a drive to learn and grow. Intermediate Excel skills (including v-lookups, pivot tables, and basic data analysis). Familiarity with or a strong eagerness to adopt AI-driven financial tools and automations to enhance AR operations. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.
